column1: # navfeeder-esp partition table for the custom GNSS color observer (ESP32-S3).
# The board carries an ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U-N16R8: 16 MB flash
# Waveshare C6's. `partitions.csv` describes the 4 MB layout and remains the table
# the C6 build uses; this file is selected only by `sdkconfig.defaults.s3`.
# Three differences from the 4 MB table
# otherwise sit idle:
#  1. On-demand HTTPS OTA uses the inactive ota_0/ota_1 slot. The factory app
#     remains the recovery image. Install the OTA-capable app and rollback
#     bootloader together over USB for the initial baseline (README.md).
#  2. The `spool` reservation grows from 1.5 MiB to 9.375 MiB. docs/PLAN.md
#     §P-spool names flash wear on a 1.5 MiB partition as the binding constraint
#     on the deferred spill tier; spreading the same erase load over 6.25x the
#     sectors is a direct relaxation of it. This is still a RESERVATION: no
#     component mounts or writes this partition on either board
#     durability envelope in README.md applies unchanged to the S3. Sizing the
#     partition does not create reboot durability.
#  3. The final 512 KiB is a separate NVS FIFO diagnostic journal. Application
#     OTA and configuration offsets are unchanged. Install this table over USB
#     once; app-only OTA cannot add a partition to an older device layout.
# Offsets left blank are computed by the partition tool. App partitions must
# start on a 64 KiB boundary
